name: Chunk-based Marching Cubes with Face Combination
definition: A meshing algorithm that processes voxel data in fixed-size chunks (Constants.ChunkSize), generating triangles for visible faces and combining adjacent coplanar faces into quads to reduce vertex count.
summary: Chunk-based Marching Cubes with Face Combination is a voxel meshing algorithm that processes 3D data in fixed-size chunks and explicitly combines adjacent coplanar faces into quads to reduce vertex count and draw calls.
